measurement: Five sequential read-only verified-TLS connections per surface; SELECT1, indexed current job and queue reads; ROLLBACK. No write lock, mutations, or credentials in report.

derived_not_observed.method: connection median + 11 * SELECT1 median; excludes lock contention, larger payloads, retries, and other job stages
derived_not_observed.applies_to: Historical implementation before bounded batch persistence

limitation: Historical measurements above separate observable event delivery from remote inference and evidence retrieval. The current implementation additionally removes SSE write-lock contention and persists bounded event batches; post-change end-to-end latency is pending live integration measurement.

read_path_optimization.event_query: Owner-scoped job/padded-sequence primary-key range, ORDER BY id, LIMIT+1
read_path_optimization.remaining_limitation: Connections remain fresh per transaction. Worker now supports bounded bulk batches; live delivery latency after batching is pending measurement.

measured_sqlite_statement_count.excludes: SQLite BEGIN and COMMIT; Aurora additionally executes the existing write-mutex SELECT

live_latency_after_batching.interpretation: Observed total includes backlog capture, trusted validation, independent model review, and Aurora publication; not isolated batch latency.

aurora_batch_statement_count_from_code.method: Five storage statements measured in isolated SQLite regression, plus the existing Aurora transaction-lock SELECT; no new Aurora write benchmark performed.
aurora_batch_statement_count_from_code.additional_control_transactions: Remote cursor checkpoints and cancellation checks are separate transactions.
